{{Quote|These are our new ships &ndash; the Annihilators. Faster and more maneuverable than any existing fighter. But with the power to breach a Star Destroyer.|Darth Krayt|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 50">[[Legacy (2006) 50|''Legacy'' (2006) 50]]</ref>}}
The '''''Annihilator''-class starfighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] manufactured by the [[One Sith]]. They were triangular in shape, and according to [[Darth Krayt]], faster and more maneuverable than any other fighter of the time. Through the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and ship would become one, and the fighters carried enough fire power to breach a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The ships, along with a number of [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] were housed in a secret location in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and were part of Darth Krayt's new offensive after his resurrection.

Months after Darth Krayt [[Assault on the Temple of the Sith|retook]] the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] throne from the usurper [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]], a large number of ''Annhilators'' were deployed alongside Emperor Krayt's [[dragon ship]]s during the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|Sith Imperial assault]] against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] of [[Taivas]], tearing through both Imperial and enemy forces, among them the [[Starrunner (Scythe-class)|''Starrunner'']]. They would also [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|fight over]] Coruscant, turning the tide in favor of the Sith until Darth Krayt died, in response to which they committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] runs.
